blocks.content: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) announced on 5 August 2026 that it will resume issuing fresh licences for Urban Cooperative Banks (UCBs) after a pause of more than two decades. The decision was announced during the August Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) meeting and is linked to draft guidelines for on-tap licensing of UCBs.

items: The RBI is the central bank of India and was established in 1935 under the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934.
Urban Cooperative Banks are part of the cooperative banking structure in India.
CRAR is a key prudential norm used to measure a bank’s capital adequacy.
Net NPA is calculated after deducting provisions from gross NPAs in banking supervision.
